recognize_zh: 腹水抹片中一顆中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質細緻略粗、可見小核仁，細胞質深藍色並佈滿大小一致的清楚圓形空泡（脂質空泡），是 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞在體液中的典型外觀。
features: Isolated medium-sized lymphoid cell with high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with finely clumped chromatin and small nucleoli
Rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple sharply punched-out clear vacuoles
Sparsely cellular background with debris; a short chain of small dark cocci adjacent to a pale degenerated cell (lower left), likely a contaminant
Only one tumor cell in the field, so overall cellularity and presence of apoptotic debris cannot be assessed
describe_en: Cytospin of ascitic fluid shows an isolated medium-sized lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, finely clumped chromatin, small nucleoli and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous discrete clear vacuoles. The background is sparsely cellular with debris; a short chain of cocci adjacent to a degenerated cell is also present and should be correlated with fluid culture to exclude infection versus contamination. Only a single abnormal cell is seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of involvement by Burkitt lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (CD10+, surface light chain-restricted B cells) and MYC rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: Cells are larger and more pleomorphic with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and cytoplasmic vacuoles are usually less uniform.
Mesothelial cells have dense cytoplasm with a peripheral clear skirt and 'windows', and macrophages have abundant pale foamy cytoplasm with low N:C ratio.
Blasts have finer chromatin with scant, usually non-vacuolated cytoplasm and are TdT positive with absent surface immunoglobulin.
Forms cohesive three-dimensional clusters with mucin vacuoles and cytokeratin/claudin-4 positivity rather than discohesive lymphoid cells.
